checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: 6-second 16:9 video of mountain lake at dusk
Gentle ripples visibly animate the water
must.why: Reflection ripple patterns differ across frames (frame 3 shows ripples).

must.item: Camera fixed, no pans, zooms or cuts
must.why: The 4.2s frame is heavily blurred/defocused with clouds appearing; framing stays the same but it reads like a focus pull/scene glitch.

must.item: No perceptible jump at loop boundary
must.why: Start and end frames match, but the mid-clip blur suggests abrupt changes; the boundary itself looks consistent.

must.item: Centre visually calm, no prominent moving foreground objects
must.why: Centre is open sky and calm water, though the blur and clouds in frame 4 are a distraction.

must.item: No visible text and no audible sound
must.why: No text visible; no sound claimed or implied.

faults.what: Around 4.2s the whole frame becomes strongly blurred/out of focus with new small clouds and blobby reflections appearing, then snaps back sharp; looks like an AI glitch and breaks the calm, still-camera feel.

summary: The lake scene is beautiful and ripples animate, but a mid-clip blur episode with appearing clouds ruins the subtle, seamless background.
